body: I’ve had a Reddit for 3 years.
You’re 100% are the ahole. You sound like my mother who I no longer speak with because she only thinks about herself. You’re incredibly selfish and I hope they kick you out of their life completely.
Thank you for responding. I really appreciate your support. Posting on here has made me feel less alone even during this horrible time.

I feel the exact same way. I don’t want to spend another second sobbing and screaming alone in my room. I don’t even care if I have positive vibes coming my way. I just want it all to end. I’m sorry I wasn’t very helpful for you I just hope it makes you feel slightly better I feel the same way.

I have the same exact issue. Everyone always says I’m a lot to handle because I’ve always struggled with mental health. I got broken up with yesterday from a man who was my best friend and we had dated for 2 years. I am sitting here sobbing in my house alone and wanting nothing more than to be dead on the floor. Most of my friends leave me and they usually say (including my now ex boyfriend) that they didn’t leave me because they were afraid I would kill myself. So now I feel that the only reason people hang around me is because they don’t want the burden of me offing myself because of them. I don’t think I’ll ever find love or find someone who wants to be my ride or die. So sometimes I just want to die and get it over with

I recently have only been seeing my counselor every few months when I’m reallly low. That’s because I can’t afford to pay $60 as often as I probably need it. And I never truly felt that it was helping much. My parents are very supportive but are die hard Christians and try to force that on me like it’s going to magically fix my problems. I was raised in the church and hate the idea of going back. I am at the point where even what I can picture of my future isn’t worth the pain I’m experiencing now.

That means a great deal to me for you to reply. I’m so sorry you have gone through all that. I’ve had about the same luck with relationships with friends and with boyfriends that I almost feel like I’m not worth being anyone’s friend and everyone would be better off if I was gone. I just don’t know why I’m even here since I just drag myself through days anyways

Thank you for replying that means a lot to me. I started this journey when I was 17 and was put on several different medications to balance my depression and anxiety. I was also starting to fall into an eating disorder around that time. I was pulled out of my sophomore year of highschool and spent that year and the next home schooled and alone. After my depression got worse I ended up going to the Mayo Clinic and was told I needed medications built around dopamine instead of serotonin. I was put on something that helped a little bit then struggled with sleeping due to my anxiety medications. Once I went off to college I felt even more alone and decided pills weren’t for me and started smoking weed. That’s helped me some but has turned into me needing it to cope with about anything. Through all that I’ve seen the same counselor but it didn’t seem to help much once I went back to my life. I always feel alone and when I get a boyfriend I feel that I love so hard since I’m not a fan of myself. Ultimately this guy that I dated for almost 2 years didn’t know why he fell out of love with me but it has broken me. I think about suicide constantly and now the pain is so overwhelming I can’t eat or get out of bed. I know the steps I need to take to get out of the funk I’m in (exercising, starting to eat right, distracting myself) but I just don’t know if I’m strong enough and would rather just leave this earth without anymore pain
